app.title: I-have-ADHD: A skill to stop coding agents from burying the answer
app.author: domhudson
app.description: A Python library that adds a safeguard to LLM-powered coding agents, preventing them from burying the answer in generated code blocks.
proposed_tests: import i_have_adhd and run a sample guard on a dummy LLM response
measure response time overhead with and without guard
verify that answer is not buried in a code block when guard enabled
